rules.accepted_credit_types: No course pre-approval; any coursework directly related to the practice of physical therapy that meets the Board's General Guidelines (1 hour = 50 minutes). Non-traditional credit: PT academic coursework (15 h per semester hour), residency/fellowship (15 h per 1,000 h), specialty certification (3 h initial, 1 h recert), publications (2-5 h), teaching CE (2 h per hour taught), peer review of practice once every 5 years (3 h); limited activities (abstracts, reviewer, posters, clinical instructor 1 h per 200 h, media) max 40% of the annual requirement. In-services, CPR and blood-borne pathogen training are not accepted.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed by exam in the previous calendar year: only 2 hours of Alabama jurisprudence at the first renewal. Licensed by endorsement in the previous calendar year: 2 hours jurisprudence + 8 hours CE (10 total).
rules.carryover: Hours above 10 may be carried into the next compliance period, max 10 hours.
rules.audit_note: CE certificates are uploaded with the renewal application; keep records 5 years. If an audited activity is unacceptable, 60 days to make it up.

topics.who: Alabama PT jurisprudence (Practice Act and Administrative Code) in renewal years ending in 0 or 5 (2030, 2035 ...); also at the first renewal. General ethics courses do not count.

rules.legal_basis: Ala. Admin. Code Chapter 700-X (Board of Physical Therapy rules)
rules.notes: Annual renewal July 1 - September 30; licenses expire October 1. Compliance period October 1 - September 30. PTs who see patients without a referral (direct access) need 2 additional hours each year on the professional standard of care (12 hours total).
rules.rule_quote: Renewals are annual. Each license expires on October 1 of the year following its issuance. Annual renewal period is July 1 through September 30 at midnight. Annual renewal fees ($93 for PTA and $130 for PT). 10 hours of continuing education are required with the renewal application.
